Why

The original bounded numerical audit has now stopped, while C2 training continues. The report needs to preserve completed results, censored work, failed sentinels, raw costs and exact source identities without interpreting metadata collection or a finite-fixture pass as whole-training numerical admission.

## Changes

This draft retains the earlier C2 launch and CI provenance snapshots and adds three separately verified stages:

1. A 113-file C2 progress appendix preserves complete-epoch observations, the first actual producer terminal, independent terminal-auditor preparation, resource-analysis planning, prior verification and publication records.
2. A 215-file terminal numerical appendix preserves the original hard-stop evidence, 96-stage roster, full-result capsule, collector and authenticated draft-archive receipts, independent JSON review, short-time mathematical note and fixed 48-case diagnostic, later C2 observations, and current CI failure evidence.
3. CURRENT and the science workflow consume all ten evidence manifests. One exact original Git API response containing ZIP Base64 is excluded from prose spelling; its bytes remain manifest-checked. No evidence directory is broadly excluded and no numerical gate is relaxed.

Production numerical/model code and the six original C2 fits are unchanged by these stages.

## Numerical result and limits

The original audit stopped at its predeclared 10,800-second process-group limit. It was not extended or restarted. Across 96 planned stages, 85 have complete receipts, one finite stage is attempted and censored, and ten stages were not observed to start. Among 60 finite cases, 49 completed cases pass the original named scaled/source/input/resource gates; the other eleven receive no admission.

The maximum completed scaled error is 0.8571803953%. The maximum relative error is 5.07008341%. The original scaled denominator is `max(1, abs(reference))`; a scaled pass does not imply 1% relative accuracy.

All six original best models still fail both tiny-gap infinite-repeat sentinels. The ordinary FP64 finite-difference gate still contains 576 unresolved checks and six resolved discrepancies. The high-precision comparisons are retained separately. The fixed 48-case diagnostic explains distinct source-cell quadrature, repeated projection and age-transport issues; it does not quantify the contribution to those twelve production failures or withdraw them.

An independent source-bound review checked the 96-stage roster, 342 artifact bindings, all 196 reported quantities from the 49 completed finite cases, and the 85 complete outer receipts. The original audit's 10,278.141465 waited CPU seconds remain a lower bound because the killed active worker was not reaped by that controller. Collector and publisher costs are separate and nested clocks are not added.

The full numerical archive and the original collector receipts were each uploaded once to the existing draft release and fully read back with authenticated size/SHA/CRC/member checks. The release remains a draft; this is no release publication.

## C2 scope in this committed snapshot

The latest archived observation is 2026-11-10 22:45:40 UTC. Five fits remain active at 64–65 complete epochs. Seed 211 / LR 0.003 is the only producer terminal, at 50 epochs, with the same strict-best checkpoint and full best-metric dictionary as its original parent. Its cumulative complete-wrapper wall bill is 15,643.131377664628 seconds. Producer adequacy is not independent terminal-auditor approval.

The 28-test independent terminal auditor is frozen but has not run on actual C2 terminal inputs. All six candidates must terminate before full source/state/gradient-trace/fresh-D validation and the separate extended resource comparison. The original 300/900/1800-second views remain unchanged.

E was not model-scored by this campaign. The legacy loader did interpret E schema, coordinate/label validity, clock and global-gap information; historical schema/feature blindness is not claimed. This explicitly corrects the earlier frozen appendix's overly broad “E remains unread” sentence without changing that original evidence.

## Verification of this update

- Ten manifests: **1,581 files, 99 directly stored ZIPs, 446 relative links, zero errors**.
- Exact committed Git objects: **1,595 distinct regular files**, zero errors, at local commit `c1dde00cd62539d53dc8b00c726f63fc2d0048a3`.
- Published remote head: `b908827abcf60b7ce22fe1b8b299206a31484550`.
- Whole published tree equals the locally verified tree: `573c6399fcc2c2b9ef4197f4f503520cde3cad51`.
- Codespell 2.4.3 and `just fmt` pass; frozen evidence bytes are unchanged.
- All 331 added/changed blobs are below 500,000 bytes. All 33 binary objects were checked against their expected Git identities.
- One binary-object transfer lost its connection. The interrupted expected SHA was checked and returned 404, then the missing immutable objects were uploaded. No branch update occurred before all three whole-tree checks passed; the final ref move used an expected-SHA nonforce update.
- The preceding source head's science run 42907725860 succeeded, while repository-wide blocking CI had failures, including the preserved readiness-discovery error for the already-empty root README. This does not claim the new head's hosted CI or repository-wide success.

## Remaining work

P1 whole-training numerical qualification and scientific benefit remain HOLD. C2 complete terminal evidence and independent quality/cost analysis remain pending. The original 12-configuration / three-seed tuning plus five fresh confirmation-seed protocol is not complete. Optimal free-boundary task benefit, broader asynchronous multimodal training and P5 scaling/hardware admission are not established.

Why

The original bounded numerical audit has now stopped, while C2 training continues. The report needs to preserve completed results, censored work, failed sentinels, raw costs and exact source identities without interpreting metadata collection or a finite-fixture pass as whole-training numerical admission.

## Changes

This draft retains the earlier C2 launch and CI provenance snapshots and adds three separately verified stages:

1. A 113-file C2 progress appendix preserves complete-epoch observations, the first actual producer terminal, independent terminal-auditor preparation, resource-analysis planning, prior verification and publication records.
2. A 215-file terminal numerical appendix preserves the original hard-stop evidence, 96-stage roster, full-result capsule, collector and authenticated draft-archive receipts, independent JSON review, short-time mathematical note and fixed 48-case diagnostic, later C2 observations, and current CI failure evidence.
3. CURRENT and the science workflow consume all ten evidence manifests. One exact original Git API response containing ZIP Base64 is excluded from prose spelling; its bytes remain manifest-checked. No evidence directory is broadly excluded and no numerical gate is relaxed.

Production numerical/model code and the six original C2 fits are unchanged by these stages.

## Numerical result and limits

The original audit stopped at its predeclared 10,800-second process-group limit. It was not extended or restarted. Across 96 planned stages, 85 have complete receipts, one finite stage is attempted and censored, and ten stages were not observed to start. Among 60 finite cases, 49 completed cases pass the original named scaled/source/input/resource gates; the other eleven receive no admission.

The maximum completed scaled error is 0.8571803953%. The maximum relative error is 5.07008341%. The original scaled denominator is `max(1, abs(reference))`; a scaled pass does not imply 1% relative accuracy.

All six original best models still fail both tiny-gap infinite-repeat sentinels. The ordinary FP64 finite-difference gate still contains 576 unresolved checks and six resolved discrepancies. The high-precision comparisons are retained separately. The fixed 48-case diagnostic explains distinct source-cell quadrature, repeated projection and age-transport issues; it does not quantify the contribution to those twelve production failures or withdraw them.

An independent source-bound review checked the 96-stage roster, 342 artifact bindings, all 196 reported quantities from the 49 completed finite cases, and the 85 complete outer receipts. The original audit's 10,278.141465 waited CPU seconds remain a lower bound because the killed active worker was not reaped by that controller. Collector and publisher costs are separate and nested clocks are not added.

The full numerical archive and the original collector receipts were each uploaded once to the existing draft release and fully read back with authenticated size/SHA/CRC/member checks. The release remains a draft; this is no release publication.

## C2 scope in this committed snapshot

The latest archived observation is 2026-11-10 22:45:40 UTC. Five fits remain active at 64–65 complete epochs. Seed 211 / LR 0.003 is the only producer terminal, at 50 epochs, with the same strict-best checkpoint and full best-metric dictionary as its original parent. Its cumulative complete-wrapper wall bill is 15,643.131377664628 seconds. Producer adequacy is not independent terminal-auditor approval.

The 28-test independent terminal auditor is frozen but has not run on actual C2 terminal inputs. All six candidates must terminate before full source/state/gradient-trace/fresh-D validation and the separate extended resource comparison. The original 300/900/1800-second views remain unchanged.

E was not model-scored by this campaign. The legacy loader did interpret E schema, coordinate/label validity, clock and global-gap information; historical schema/feature blindness is not claimed. This explicitly corrects the earlier frozen appendix's overly broad “E remains unread” sentence without changing that original evidence.

## Verification of this update

- Ten manifests: **1,581 files, 99 directly stored ZIPs, 446 relative links, zero errors**.
- Exact committed Git objects: **1,595 distinct regular files**, zero errors, at local commit `c1dde00cd62539d53dc8b00c726f63fc2d0048a3`.
- Published remote head: `b908827abcf60b7ce22fe1b8b299206a31484550`.
- Whole published tree equals the locally verified tree: `573c6399fcc2c2b9ef4197f4f503520cde3cad51`.
- Codespell 2.4.3 and `just fmt` pass; frozen evidence bytes are unchanged.
- All 331 added/changed blobs are below 500,000 bytes. All 33 binary objects were checked against their expected Git identities.
- One binary-object transfer lost its connection. The interrupted expected SHA was checked and returned 404, then the missing immutable objects were uploaded. No branch update occurred before all three whole-tree checks passed; the final ref move used an expected-SHA nonforce update.
- The preceding source head's science run 42907725860 succeeded, while repository-wide blocking CI had failures, including the preserved readiness-discovery error for the already-empty root README. This does not claim the new head's hosted CI or repository-wide success.

## Remaining work

P1 whole-training numerical qualification and scientific benefit remain HOLD. C2 complete terminal evidence and independent quality/cost analysis remain pending. The original 12-configuration / three-seed tuning plus five fresh confirmation-seed protocol is not complete. Optimal free-boundary task benefit, broader asynchronous multimodal training and P5 scaling/hardware admission are not established.
